title: +A-Channel 1 - Uniform
overview: Tooru shows her newly received High School uniform to Run.

title: +A-Channel 2 - Nooo!
overview: Yuuko is tricked into watching a scary movie.

title: +A-Channel 3 - Participation
overview: Ms. Kitō becomes annoyed when Mr. Satō interrupts her class.

title: +A-Channel 4 - There She Is
overview: Run comes home and is surprised to find Tooru spring out of her bed.

title: +A-Channel 5 - Show Me
overview: When asked by Yūko if she would be willing to change her image, Nagi demonstrates why she hasn't really done so.

title: +A-Channel 6 - Exploring
overview: Yūko shows how bad she is at videogames before having to deal with a cockroach in her house.

title: +A-Channel 7 - Just for Today
overview: Whilst preparing for the summer festival, Nagi experiments with her hairstyle.

title: +A-Channel 8 - She's Here
overview: When Yūko misplaces her recorder, the resulting conversation leads to another misunderstanding between her and Tooru.

title: +A-Channel 9 - Scared
overview: Yūko becomes scared one night when she believes she's being followed.

title: +A-Channel 10 - Genzou-san
overview: On a cold day, Run and Nagi discuss what could make sitting in the classroom warmer.

title: +A-Channel 11 - Character Bento
overview: The girls split into teams and compete with each other to make the best home-made bento lunch.
